ambiguity_classification.statement: The stabilization note should live in repo-tracked artifact-loop docs rather than planning_artifacts.
The mixed-surface smoke should use HTTP only where the plan explicitly requires proof of the service contract; the rest should stay on stable CLI flows.

non_goals: No Tailscale automation beyond documenting the current gate
No mutation of the canonical shared_coordination_v1 contract beyond bug fixes required by this pass
intent_contract.objective: Create reusable operator-facing stabilization surfaces for the newly implemented invite, team summary/brief, and adopt-existing flows without widening into new product functionality or Tailscale Stage 2/3 work.
success_criteria: A new scenario script proves invite creation over CLI, invite claim over HTTP, shared coordination over CLI, team readback over HTTP, and adopt-existing over CLI in one run.
The lead-surface review bundle captures both project-level and team-level outputs and checks that the derived team surfaces stay semantically aligned with project truth.
A repo-tracked rollout note documents slices B/C/D, stabilization entrypoints, operator commands, constraints, and the explicit gate for re-entering runtime work.
